items.question: Is Kairo free for individual job seekers?
items.answer: Yes. Our Basic Plan includes smart skill matching, 10 saved opportunities and weekly compensation insights at zero cost.

items.question: How does Kairo verify company compensation bands?
items.answer: Hiring partners publish active base salary ranges before roles go live, validated against regional market benchmarks across 40+ cities.

items.question: Can I switch between Monthly and Yearly billing anytime?
items.answer: Yes. Upgrade, switch to Yearly billing to save 20%, or pause your Pro subscription inside your account with zero lock-in fees.

items.question: Do recruiters see my profile before I apply?
items.answer: Only when you opt in to Verified Discovery. You control full visibility for current employers and private portfolio links.

items.question: How fast do hiring teams respond on Kairo?
items.answer: Verified studios commit to clear 5-business-day status updates so you are never left guessing inside automated black boxes.

items.question: Does Kairo support remote and international roles?
items.answer: Yes. Filter opportunities seamlessly by remote-first, hybrid hub cities, relocation sponsorship and timezone overlap.
